WITH rental_film AS (
  SELECT f.rating, f.film_id
  FROM rental r
  INNER JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  INNER JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
distinct_films_per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS film_count
  FROM rental_film
  GROUP BY rating
),
rating_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    rating, 
    film_count,
    1.0 * film_count / SUM(film_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM distinct_films_per_rating
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS threshold_share
  FROM rating_shares
),
filtered_ratings AS (
  SELECT rs.rating, rs.film_count, rs.share, t.threshold_share
  FROM rating_shares rs
  CROSS JOIN threshold t
  WHERE rs.share > t.threshold_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(film_count) AS total_count,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(share - threshold_share) AS avg_excess
FROM filtered_ratings;

alternatives.interpretation: The phrase 'with each rating weighted equally' means the threshold should be computed as 1/5 (treating all five possible rating levels as equally weighted) rather than the arithmetic mean of shares present in the rental data.
